name: registry-tiny-agents
description: Zeptly registry of Tiny Agent Blueprints (blueprints persist; running Tiny Agents do not). Protocol conventions are PROVISIONAL.

scripts.validate: tsx tools/src/cli.ts validate . && tsx tools/src/cli.ts validate examples/registry
scripts.index: tsx tools/src/cli.ts index . && tsx tools/src/cli.ts index examples/registry
scripts.index:check: tsx tools/src/cli.ts index . --check && tsx tools/src/cli.ts index examples/registry --check
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run vectors && npm run validate && npm run index:check
